expectations.buyer: Regulated enterprises, governments, critical-infrastructure operators, and procurement/security teams managing foreign-vendor dependency
expectations.pain: Organizations cannot prove they can rebuild, sign, modify, recover, and operate critical systems when a vendor, cloud, signing service, or jurisdiction becomes unavailable
expectations.strongestIncumbent: Software escrow, source-available delivery, disaster recovery, SBOM and reproducible-build tooling, sovereign cloud, continuity audits, and procurement clauses
expectations.biggestRisk: The full drill is expensive, hardware and licensing rights remain inaccessible, and incumbent escrow/continuity audits may satisfy procurement
